title: Guided production testing and reliability acceptance
focus: Replace technical-only deployment notes with detailed staff-facing production test instructions and audit records for notification, payment, privacy, upload, proof, incident, retention, and end-to-end workflows.
completed_20: Added a dedicated Guided Production Test Centre at /admin-test-centre.html with exact click-by-click steps, expected outcomes, and failure-recording instructions.
Added a safe internal-test preflight that warns against using real customer data, payment cards, secrets, addresses, VINs, or private evidence.

Added nine structured acceptance tests covering environment readiness, notifications, Stripe checkout, customer privacy, mobile uploads, proof completion, incident/review safety, retention, and end-to-end flow.
Added database-backed production_test_runs audit history with pass, fail, blocked, and not-started outcomes.
Added /api/admin/production_test_runs_list for staff-protected playbook/history loading.
Added /api/admin/production_test_run_save for validated result recording without storing secrets.
Added browser-only fallback storage when the Build 212 test-run migration has not yet been applied.
Added links from Production Readiness to Guided Test Centre.
Added production report test counts for passed, failed, blocked, and not-started acceptance tests.
Added production-readiness attention items for failed/blocked test outcomes and no recorded test history.
Added Today Needs Attention coverage for guided test failures and missing acceptance history.
Added build-safe test evidence URL validation.
Added copyable test steps for use while testing from a phone/tablet.
Added responsive test cards, mobile-friendly action buttons, safe overflow handling, and reduced reliance on tiny technical endpoint labels.
Added a guided-production-test visual placeholder with explicit no-customer-data guidance.
Updated service-worker cache and route-copy synchronization for the new test centre.
Added a deployable SQL migration for production test audit records and indexes.
Added a detailed production test guide in docs for testing outside the app.
Updated canonical handoff/roadmap, schema documents, root Markdown sync notes, and documentation governance markers.
Added a Build 212 release guard and integrated it into the release check chain.
next_20: Configure and verify the real email notification provider with a controlled mailbox.
Configure SMS only after explicit consent, sender identity, quiet hours, and cost controls are approved.
Verify Stripe final-balance test checkout plus webhook settlement using actual Stripe test events.
Add PayPal hosted final-balance checkout parity only if it remains a business requirement.
Implement verified webhook reconciliation for Stripe final-balance Checkout Sessions.
Replace upload retry-from-start with true resumable/multipart upload for larger field videos.
Add client-side video compression/transcoding only after real-device testing establishes a safe need.
Add alert thresholds and scheduled notifications for failed uploads, failed notifications, and overdue payment links.
Add scheduled retention review with explicit archive approval and object-level audit trail before any deletion.
Add an orphaned-object detector comparing R2/Supabase storage paths with job_media rows.
Add one-click recovery actions in Today Needs Attention with confirmation and audit reason prompts.
Add automated end-to-end smoke checks for non-secret API contracts in a preview deployment.
Capture accessibility acceptance results for keyboard controls, focus states, captions, and screen-reader labels.
Add customer notification preferences and quiet-hour delivery rules.
Add payment-link expiry, resend, and customer-safe status updates.
Add a closeout job packet PDF only after customer privacy and retention controls are validated.
Add a route/time clustering experiment using only staff-approved service-area data.
Run one actual internal job simulation on a phone over Wi-Fi and cellular and record results.
Review the two active canonical docs after production testing and promote only confirmed readiness claims.
Remove or simplify any owner screen that does not feed the connected lifecycle or Today Needs Attention queue.
acceptance_path: Run environment preflight with an internal test booking
Run privacy and mobile upload tests before any real customer job
Record each status and safe evidence link
Do not claim production readiness until urgent failures are resolved
